rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Embeds GDPR compliance knowledge directly into development workflows. Provides tools for GDPR article and recital lookup, Data Protection Impact Assessment evaluation using EDPB criteria, Records of Processing Activities generation per Article 30, and data subject rights guidance covering Articles 12-23. Includes infrastructure-as-code analysis for Bicep, Terraform, and ARM templates, application code scanning for PII logging and consent gaps, cross-border transfer detection, and breach readiness assessment. Ships with 19 GDPR-aligned Azure Bicep templates for common cloud resources.
